solution.en: You can find Excel Customer Support Point information from the official support page.
solution.bn: Excel Customer Support Point তথ্য official support page থেকে পাওয়া যাবে।

escalation_message.en: Visit https://www.excelbd.com/support/ and choose your nearest support point.
escalation_message.bn: https://www.excelbd.com/support/ ভিজিট করে nearest support point নির্বাচন করুন।

solution.en: For direct support, contact your nearest Excel Customer Support Point from the official support page.
solution.bn: direct support এর জন্য official support page থেকে nearest Excel Customer Support Point-এ যোগাযোগ করুন।

solution.en: For product price, availability, and dealer location, contact Excel sales/support from the official website.
solution.bn: product price, availability এবং dealer location জানতে official website থেকে Excel sales/support-এ যোগাযোগ করুন।

escalation_message.en: Visit https://www.excelbd.com/support/ for support and contact details.
escalation_message.bn: support এবং contact details জানতে https://www.excelbd.com/support/ ভিজিট করুন।
